response.overview: Beyond the known galaxy lies Droyodidjy, a hyper-advanced world veiled in nebulas and swarming with bio-mechanical leviathans. When an ancient cosmic eclipse strikes, the terrifying alpha-monster Nattirah captures Vasudha and retreats to an unstable extra-dimensional planet.Driven by boundless love, Dr. E. Sreehari  merges his deep medical knowledge with the Golden Mecha’s core, synchronizing his heartbeat and soul into the ultimate diamond-powered titan suit. Dr E.Sreehari braves toxic alien atmospheres, slays monstrous beasts, and plunges directly into the heart of the shadow dimension.Inside the abyss, Nattirah’s psychic hold threatens all, but Dr E.Sreehari’s romantic bond with Vasudha serves as the sole light capable of shattering the darkness.
response.tagline: Beyond cosmic light, their love is the ultimate force
